P.name: Deadly Venom
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Twitch's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Deadly Venom'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 6 times.
P.description2: {{sbc|Deadly Venom:}} For each stack, the target is dealt{{ft|{{sti|true damage|{{as|{{pp|1 to 5 for 5|1 to 17|formula=1 every 4 levels}}|true damage}}}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}} {{as|true damage}} per second over the duration,|{{sti|true damage|{{as|{{pp|1*6 to 5*6 for 5|1 to 17|formula=1, +1 every 4 levels}}|true damage}}}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:3*6}}% AP)}} {{as|'''total''' true damage}} over the duration,}}for a maximum of{{ft|{{as|{{pp|1*6 to 5*6 for 5|1 to 17|formula=6 every 4 levels}}|true damage}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:3*6}}% AP)}} {{as|true damage}} with each tick.|{{as|{{pp|1*6*6 to 5*6*6 for 5|1 to 17|formula=6 every 4 levels}}|true damage}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:3*6*6}}% AP)}} {{as|'''total''' true damage}} over the duration.}}This effect is considered a {{tip|poison}}.

Q.name: Ambush
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After a 1-second delay, '''Twitch''' becomes {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} for a duration. Attacking or casting ''{{ai|Venom Cask|Twitch}}'' or ''{{ai|Contaminate|Twitch}}'' ends ''Ambush'' immediately.
Q.description2: During this time, '''Twitch''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while facing enemy {{tip|champions}} within a 1000-unit radius who cannot see him.
Q.description3: Upon breaking stealth, '''Twitch''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 6 seconds.
Q.description4: When an enemy {{tip|champion}} dies while afflicted with ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'', ''Ambush's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reset.

W.name: Venom Cask
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Twitch''' hurls a cask of corrosive mixture at the target location that breaks upon landing, applying ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'' to enemies in the area and granting {{tip|sight}} of it.
W.description2: The area then becomes contaminated for 3 seconds, applying a ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'' stack each second to enemies within and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them.

E.name: Contaminate
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Twitch''' sends out a lethal toxin to each nearby enemy afflicted by ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'', dealing them {{as|physical damage}}.
E.description2: ''Contaminate'' deals additional {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|35% AP}} {{as|magic damage}} for each stack of ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'' on the target.
E.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage Per Stack|{{ap|15 to 35}} {{as|(+ 35% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Minimum Mixed Damage|{{ap|20+15 to 60+35}} {{as|(+ 35% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Maximum Mixed Damage|{{ap|20+15*6 to 60+35*6}} {{as|(+ 210% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35*6}}% AP)}}}}
E.description3: ''A nearby enemy with {{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}} is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be targeted by this ability.''

R.name: Spray and Pray
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Twitch''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and {{sti|range|300 '''bonus''' attack range}} for 6 seconds, during which his {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} are replaced by ''bolts'' that travel slightly further than his attack range in a straight line, dealing damage to {{tt|every enemy unit|non-champions and champions, wards and plants, turrets and structures}} hit.
R.description2: The ''bolts'' deal {{pp|key=%|type=enemies hit|110-10*x|0 to 4 for 5|formula=100% - 10% per enemy hit. ''This is capped at 60% damage.''|changedisplay=true}} of the triggering {{as|attack's damage|AD}}, apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Twitch|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage.
